query: Lee Jae-myung approval rating Gallup Korea Realmeter late June early July 2026, is approval still falling, what is driving the decline, any dead cross
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on Lee Jae-myung's approval ratings for late June/early July 2026:

**Is approval still falling?** No longer — both pollsters show a trough in late June followed by early-July stabilization/rebound.

**Gallup Korea:** Bottomed at **51%** (June 24-26, lowest since inauguration), rebounded to **54%** (June 30-July 2), eased to **53%** (July 7-9). **No dead cross** — disapproval peaked at 41%.

**Realmeter:** Registered a **dead cross** in the June 22 release (approval 46.7% vs disapproval 49.7%) — the first reversal since Lee took office. Fell six straight weeks to 46.5% (June 29), then rose for the first time in seven weeks to 47.0% (July 6), though disapproval still led.

**Drivers of decline:** Economy/cost-of-living, weak Korean won, falling stock prices, foreign exchange concerns, housing policy, and alleged National Election Commission irregularities.

**Stabilization driver:** The government's "three mega projects" investment plan (~$3.11T in semiconductors, physical AI, AI data centers).

**Key caveat:** Whether there was a "dead cross" depends entirely on the pollster — Realmeter (larger sample, runs lower) crossed; Gallup (runs higher) never did.
